title: Exact affine stalk homology in scalar-extension coordinates
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, C a complex of A-modules, p a prime, and i an integer. Let D be the structure-sheaf stalk of Spec(A) at p, kappa:A to D its canonical map, F extension of scalars along kappa, N=tilde(C), and s the module stalk functor. There exists a D-linear chain isomorphism chi:F(C) to s(N), sending 1 tensor x to the germ of x in each degree. There also exist additive equivalences e(V):V_p to F(V), for every A-module V, such that for every A-linear a:V to H^i(C) and x in V_p, affineTildeHomologyLocalization(localize(a)(x)) equals H^i(chi) applied to the inverse exact scalar-extension homology isomorphism applied to F(a)(e(V)(x)). The homology localization map is the existing construction of [lem-pc-affine-ordinary-tensor-stalk-coordinates]. No derived tensor model or K-flatness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 01I9, 01HV and 01AG; functorial tilde localization and exact stalk homology in the affine argument of Tag 0DJ8.

proof.text: The stalk ring is the prime localization and toStalk on tilde modules is a module localization. IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange gives a stalk-ring-linear isomorphism from scalar extension to the stalk, with its numerator formula. Tensor generation and naturality of germs prove naturality. Apply these components to the differentials to construct chi. Use IsLocalizedModule.iso followed by the inverse scalar-extension/stalk isomorphism to construct e(V).

Naturality of the localization isomorphism (Mathlib IsLocalizedModule.map_iso_commute) and of the termwise scalar-extension/stalk isomorphism identifies the image of localize(a)(x) with its scalar-extension image. Exact tilde and exact stalks give their homology isomorphisms. Cancel the cycle inclusions and homology quotient maps to show that the homology isomorphism of a composite exact functor equals the composite homology isomorphisms. Apply Mathlib NatTrans.app_homology to the termwise natural isomorphism. This proves the homology square. Expanding affineTildeHomologyLocalization cancels the two inverse homologyFunctorFactors maps, leaving exactly the composite exact tilde/stalk homology map. Substitute the numerator naturality equality to obtain the claimed formula.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineStalkScalarExtensionCoordinates
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (i : ℤ) :
    let D : Type u := (Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.stalk p
    let κ := (StructureSheaf.toStalk A p).hom
    let F := ModuleCat.extendScalars κ
    letI := ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat
      (RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr (IsLocalization.flat D p.asIdeal.primeCompl))
    let N := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj C)
    let s := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace p
    ∃ χ : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        (s.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N,
      (∀ (j : ℤ) (x : C.X j), χ.hom.f j ((1 : D) ⊗ₜ[A, κ] x) =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ (N.X j).val.presheaf ⊤ p trivial
          (tilde.toOpen (R := .of A) (C.X j) ⊤ x)) ∧
      ∃ e : ∀ U : ModuleCat.{u} A,
          LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl U ≃+ F.obj U,
        ∀ (U : ModuleCat.{u} A) (a : U ⟶ C.homology i) (x),
          affineTildeHomologyLocalization A C p i
              (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl a.hom x) =
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap χ.hom i
              (((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso F).inv (F.map a (e U x)))
